about: Senso's printed Fall Menu (Kian, 2026-10-12, via the PM), placed in Senso's Seasonal section in the card's order, tagged fall only, shown. Applied by tools/import/seasonal-menu-apply.mjs (npm run setup applies every data/import/*/<venue>/*-menu.json after the Persian review records). Each item is an existing Senso item, matched by its import key (Kian: reuse, no duplicates); nothing is created. Names in title case; Persian names are the card's text (source, not drafts); Persian descriptions are drafts, flagged per field, for Kian's review in the admin. Photos are left as they are (Kian, 2026-10-12: keep them; he uploads his own in the admin). An item is applied once: a later edit in the admin wins over a re-run. See import-report.md.

source.transcription: the PM's, 2026-10-12; every name, Persian name, price and description checked against the card photo: all six lines match (import-report.md)
